mapper.select: /* PdaOutReleasePaotMapper.selectExistBlDivideByBms5HF : 박스스캔시 BL분할 존재하는지 조회 */ SELECT I.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , I.OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_BMS_5HF H INNER JOIN TB_BMS_IN I WITH (NOLOCK) ON H.NEW_IN_NO = I.IN_NO WHERE H.DIVIDE_CLASS = '1' AND H.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{srchCargoReferenceNo}
mapper.delete: /* PdaOutReleasePaotMapper.deleteStockPkgScan : 재고실사 스캔 정보 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_BMS_STOCK_PKG_SCAN WHERE SCAN_NO = #{scanNo} AND SCAN_RESULT = '완료'
mapper.select: /* PdaOutReleasePaotMapper.selectOutPlanListCtByCargoNoAndOutClass : 반출구분에 따른 반출승인의 승인수량 */ SELECT ISNULL(APPROVAL_CT, 0) AS APPROVAL_CT , ISNULL(OUT_SCAN_CT, 0) AS OUT_SCAN_CT , OUT_PLAN_NO , OUT_APPROVAL_NO , OUT_CLASS FROM TB_BMS_OUT_PLAN WHERE CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{cargoReferenceNo} AND OUT_CLASS IN (#{item}) AND APPROVAL_CLASS = '31'
mapper.delete: /* PdaOutReleasePaotMapper.deleteBmsOutScanLog : 출고 스캔로그 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_BMS_OUT_SCAN WHERE SCAN_NO = #{srchPackingNo} AND SCAN_RESULT = '완료'
mapper.select: /* PdaOutReleasePaotMapper.selectXrayPassTime : 화물 조회 - 판독 일시 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 FORMAT(CAST(REGISTER_DATE_TIME AS DATETIME), 'yy.MM.dd HH:mm:ss') AS XRAY_PASS_TIME FROM TB_BMS_XRAY_HISTORY WHERE PACKING_NO = #{srchPackingNo} ORDER BY REGISTER_DATE_TIME DESC
